How to skip the line at your next event, in 4 steps:

1️⃣ Scan the QR on a banner or table tent

4️⃣ Get your queue number and go enjoy the event

Vendors, this one’s for you.

NO-Q puts your menu on every phone at the event:

1️⃣ Build your menu once: photos, prices, options and stock
2️⃣ Print your own storefront QR for your booth
3️⃣ Connect payouts through Stripe

Invited to an event that uses NO-Q? Sign up through the organizer’s link. Questions? DM us or visit no-q.ca

posts.caption:
Every order, live. ⚡

Orders show up on your NO-Q dashboard as guests place them, with a new-order alert. Start it, mark it ready for pickup, mark it picked up. One tap each.

Already run a kitchen display or POS? Connect it and get NO-Q orders there instead.

#NOQ #SkipTheLine #EventTech #MobileOrdering #FoodVendor #KitchenLife #SmallBusiness
alt_text: An unfolded iPhone Duo showing Island Grill’s NO-Q orders list, with new orders and Start Order and Complete Order buttons. Headline: “Every order, live.”

posts.caption:
Nothing hurts like refunding a plate you already ran out of.

Set your stock count in NO-Q and every sale counts it down. Sold a few at the window? Tap −.

Guests see “Only 4 left” when you’re running low and “Sold out” when it’s gone, so you never sell what you don’t have.

#NOQ #SkipTheLine #EventTech #MobileOrdering #FoodVendor #InventoryManagement #SmallBusiness
